# Mramornaya cooked smoked sausage

Chicken and beef sausage with a savoury spiced profile.

- Net weight: 500 g
- Halal verified: Certificate No. 614A/2024
- Without nitrite

## Ingredients

Chicken thigh fillet, poultry skin, beef, beef fat, drinking water, table salt, fruit and spice extracts (pomelo, lemon, black and white pepper blend), salt, grape sugar, maltodextrin, dried glucose syrup, yeast extract, meat-flavour flavouring, Barbados cherry extract, dried lemon juice, spices and extracts (black and white pepper, nutmeg, garlic, allspice), citrus extracts (lemon, lime, orange, pomelo), glucose, meat-type flavouring, nutmeg, ginger and coriander extracts, beef-flavour meat-type flavouring.

**Allergens:** None declared in the current recipe
